question: What is the meaning of renewable in relation to biological?
description: Renewable energy sources, such as solar and wind power, are biological in nature and can be replenished naturally. This means that they are not finite and can be used sustainably over time. In contrast, non-renewable energy sources, such as fossil fuels, are finite and will eventually run out. Therefore, renewable energy sources are considered more sustainable and environmentally friendly.
